people.name: Shawn Crahan
people.extract: Michael Shawn Crahan, more commonly known by his stage persona "Clown", is an American musician. He is the co-founder and percussionist of the alternative metal band Slipknot, in which he is designated #6. He helped form Slipknot in 1995 alongside bassist Paul Gray and former vocalist Anders Colsefni. Crahan is the longest-serving member of the band, and also has extensive involvement with Slipknot's media production and music videos. Outside Slipknot, Crahan had two side project bands called To My Surprise and Dirty Little Rabbits. Aside from his musical activity, he also directed the 2016 action thriller film Officer Downe.
highlights: Co-founder and percussionist of the band Slipknot.

people.name: Jean Servais
people.extract: Jean Servais was a Belgian film and stage actor. He acted in many 20th century French cinema productions, from the 1930s through the early 1970s.
highlights: Acted in many 20th century French cinema productions.
